title: Staged connectivity orchestration & fastlane for Private/VPC on-prem requests
creator: Maya Thompson
description:
Problem: Enterprise customers requesting Private / VPC / on-prem deployments frequently get blocked by network constraints (strict egress policies, air-gapped environments, restrictive proxies) and upgrade scheduling. Intake currently yields long lead times because engineering needs customer networking details, produces ad-hoc proxy bridges, and coordinates manual smoke tests.

Goal: Create an opinionated "staged connectivity orchestration" fastlane that standardizes network bridging options, self-serve probing, and a scripted rollback plan so high-priority customers can be onboarded 3x faster while preserving security and upgrade safety. The fastlane should cover: ephemeral proxy bridge patterns, customer-initiated connectivity probes, cert/material exchange checklist, staged upgrade windows, and automated observability hooks for early failure detection.

Scope: This ticket defines the PM scope, acceptance criteria, stakeholder signoffs, high-level implementation approach, and a prioritized rollout plan for the fastlane MVP. Implementation tasks (engineering/design) will be broken into follow-up tickets.
proposal_summary: Deliver a prescriptive orchestration flow that combines: (1) a small set of trusted bridge patterns (reverse-tunnel, proxy-broker, host-eap tunnel) with security controls and RBAC; (2) a customer self-service network readiness probe (containerized probe or simple curl-suite) that returns machine-readable diagnostics; (3) a staged connectivity runbook with verification, canary workloads, and rollback triggers; (4) template legal/compliance checklist for airgapped agreements. Provide a Console UI quick action and a CLI script used by SE/engineers to execute the fastlane on onboarding calls.
acceptance_criteria: A documented set of 3 supported bridge patterns with diagrams and threat model
A containerized network probe (docker image + CLI) that customers can run and upload results to a secure URL
A staged runbook with explicit verification steps and automated smoke-tests (latency, token auth, KV cache warming)
Console quick-action that launches a guided fastlane flow for SEs, with links to probe output and a decision checklist
Onboarding time for prioritized customers reduced from median 21 days to <= 7 days in pilot
Security signoff from InfoSec and Legal templates for certificate handling and data flows
milestones: M2: Probe CLI and sample report format (2026-03-10)
M5: Launch fastlane public SOP and SE training (2026-04-15)
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Bridge patterns may violate some customers' compliance controls. Mitigation: Provide 'no-bridge' alternative that uses local connectors and full airgap upgrade schedule; include legal template and minimum customer commitments.
Risk: Probe could leak metadata. Mitigation: probe deliberately designed to not transmit PII; results are uploader-controlled and stored to a restricted bucket with short TTL.
Risk: Console quick-action could be misused. Mitigation: expose only to SEs and ops roles; audit log each fastlane run and require approver signature for production-level changes.
decision_log: 2026-02-12: Decided to support exactly three bridge patterns to limit operational surface area (reverse-tunnel, proxy-broker, local connector).
2026-02-18: Chose containerized probe approach over downloadable binaries for easier reproducibility across customer environments.
2026-02-22: Require InfoSec signoff before any pilot; agreed on minimal telemetry and upload controls.
implementation_notes: Follow-up ENG tickets will include: ENG-211902 (probe implementation), ENG-211903 (console quick-action integration), ENG-211904 (observability hooks for fastlane), ENG-211905 (bridge operator runbook and scripts)
Design to produce 2 companion flows: SE-guided modal in Console and a README-based walk-through used in airgapped engagements.
Plan to reuse existing KMS/HSM integration for cert exchange; require Legal to bless templated CA exchange agreement.
